evidence.quote: The COVID-19 pandemic is taking a tremendous toll on communities across America, especially households and small businesses with the least liquid resources to weather the storm.
today I am pleased to announce the Federal Reserve Board has approved the core features and functionality based on extensive input from stakeholders.
The FedNow Service will facilitate end-to-end instant payment services for consumers and businesses, increase competition, and ensure equitable access to banks of all sizes nationwide.
